question:
In a certain code language,

A + B means 'A is the sister of B',

A - B means 'A is the wife of B',

A × B means 'A is the father of B',

and A ÷ B means 'A is the brother of B'.

How is P related to T if 'P + Q - R × S ÷ T'?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aecbe9ab6b7da7cca1ac2d356e84b8c992ce57c8b50affd73dfdd3dad30ceb2e.png]

Given: P + Q - R × S ÷ T

P is the Sister of Q, Q is the wife of R, R is the father of S and S is the brother of T

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d39bf933cf184040d109d806682f1eec9081a4b6d6814e192f03672e7f1443ad.png] 

So, P is the 'Mother's sister' of T.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4"
